correctness.rationale: The one-point leave is a perfect matching. Every ordered anchor pair in any puncture has the same seven-cased extension support with multiplicities 1,1,1,1,1,v-6 in the completed-pair case and positive supports in matching/equal cases. This yields a permanent symmetric three-pebble strategy preserving equality, matching and R, including all repeated-anchor cases, so all unrestricted-depth FO^3 sentences agree. Complete designs have analogous uniform pair extensions. A three-variable missing-pair formula separates full/punctured, and a four-variable two-free-witness formula separates punctures v=7 from admissible v>=9 because there are exactly v-6 free witnesses. FO^2 has only equality atoms. The two runnable checkers corroborate on four parents, all 44 deletions and exact fixed-point logical refinement; no extrapolation from tests is used.

value.rationale: An exact, natural two-class FO^3 classification across all finite Steiner triple systems and all of their point deletions gives a structural description of which information a single deletion exposes at small logical width. The leave is FO^3-definable but the parent order and geometry remain invisible; the sharp FO^4 v=7 versus v>=9 separator resolves a meaningful expressivity boundary. Unlike a restated table or routine numerical slice, it is a full unbounded-depth classification of a natural infinite design family with a motivated deletion operation.
